Actions.Name: Session
Actions.Tooltip: One Claude Code session per key: press to focus its window, long-press to pin. Drop as many as you have keys.

Actions.Name: Talk
Actions.Tooltip: Dictate into the session in front: press to talk, press again to send. A terminal session needs /voice tap in Claude Code and the chord bound (default ctrl+y); the Claude Code panel takes cmd+d.

Description: Every Claude Code session on this Mac on its own key: working, needs you, done. Press to focus the window and terminal tab; long-press to pin. Powered by corgi agent.
